steps.en: Build the local runtime and start the loopback workbench
steps.zh: 构建本地运行时，启动回环工作台

steps.en: Configure a model account and confirm the workspace
steps.zh: 配置模型账户，确认工作目录

steps.en: Install the example tool; review its hashes and enable it
steps.zh: 安装示例工具，审核摘要后启用

steps.en: Admits the reviewed plugin and registers its text-statistics tool
steps.zh: 准入审核过的插件，注册文字统计工具

steps.en: Ask the model to call demo_text_stats on hello world
steps.zh: 要求模型调用工具统计 hello world

steps.en: Runs the selected tool and records structured counts in the shared session
steps.zh: 执行选中的工具，把结构统计结果记入共享会话

value.en: Reuse an installed business tool with a shared, checkable execution record
value.zh: 复用已安装业务工具，并保留共享且可检查的执行记录
